unit.why: Three teachings attributed to the Zhidachov rebbe: an exegesis of Laban and Jacob (Gen 30) on the tzaddik's power, a gematria on trust (אבטח), and a gematria on the fingers and Shema; there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: ends with heading 'השמטות למערכת ח׳' introducing the next section
